rationale: Both original blocking findings are resolved with clear fix-up evidence. CR-001: Textarea.tsx now destructures 'aria-describedby' and 'aria-invalid' out of the incoming props before {...rest} spreads, confirmed by a new regression test (RED before: caller's aria-describedby won; GREEN after). CR-002: FilesDropzone.tsx now derives errorId via useId() combined with name instead of the raw name prop alone, confirmed by a new regression test asserting two instances sharing the same name get distinct wrapper ids (RED before: both got 'files-errors'; GREEN after). No new high-risk issue introduced by this small, mechanical fix-up (2 files, 2 new tests, both green; lint and typecheck clean), so no confirmation pass was needed.

finding_status.notes: Textarea.tsx:69-70 now destructures 'aria-describedby'/'aria-invalid' out of props before ...rest spread; regression test 'keeps the computed error association even when a caller passes its own aria-describedby/aria-invalid' confirms.
FilesDropzone.tsx:46-47 now derives errorId via useId() combined with name; regression test 'uses a unique wrapper id per instance even when two dropzones share the same name' confirms.
